title: krabka-broker
description: Reference dashboard for krabka-broker. Every series it names is checked against the registry by `aspect check-metrics-contract`.

panels.title: Under-replicated
panels.description: Alert: > 0 for 5m.

panels.title: Under min ISR
panels.description: Alert: > 0. acks=all produces fail with NOT_ENOUGH_REPLICAS.

panels.title: Offline
panels.description: Alert: > 0. These partitions serve nothing.

panels.title: Controller leader changes / s
panels.description: A sustained non-zero rate is flapping raft leadership.

panels.title: Unclean leader elections / s
panels.description: Any non-zero value accepted data loss.

panels.title: Failed Produce and Fetch partition responses / s
panels.description: Alert: produce failures > 0 for 5m.

panels.title: Replica lag max
panels.description: Largest follower lag on any partition the broker leads. Alert: > 10000 for 10m.

panels.title: Replica lag (top 10)
panels.description: Leader log end minus the follower's last-fetched offset, per follower.

panels.title: Consumer group lag (top 10)
panels.description: High watermark minus the group's committed offset. Alert: > 10000 for 15m.

panels.title: Request errors and unsupported versions / s
panels.description: Alert: either > 0 for 5m.

panels.title: Produce phases p99
panels.description: Remote high and local low is replication, not disk.

panels.title: Fetch phases p99
panels.description: Remote is the long poll and the tiered or diskless cold read.

panels.title: Unattributed handler time / s by API

targets.expr: sum by (api_key) (rate(krabka_broker_request_duration_seconds_sum{instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) - sum by (api_key) (rate(krabka_broker_request_local_duration_seconds_sum{instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) - sum by (api_key) (rate(krabka_broker_request_remote_duration_seconds_sum{instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) - sum by (api_key) (rate(krabka_broker_request_throttle_duration_seconds_sum{instance=~"$instance"}[5m]))

panels.description: Total minus the three phases: decode, authorization, validation and encode. Growth here is handler CPU.

panels.title: In-flight requests
panels.description: A sustained climb is a handler stall or a wedged controller.

panels.title: Fetch response drain path / s
panels.description: One increment per drained Fetch response, labelled with the strongest path its records regions took to the socket. On a plaintext cluster a sendfile rate of zero while the others carry traffic is a zero-copy regression; a TLS listener without kernel TLS (krabka_broker_ktls_enabled = 0) legitimately reports none.

panels.title: ApiVersions handshakes / s by client software
KIP-714 client metrics export failures / s
Partition CPU occupancy (top 10)
panels.description: Cores spent on one partition's handlers.

panels.title: Tiered storage RLMM
panels.description: Attempts with topic backed at 0 is a stuck bootstrap.

panels.title: Log cleaner failures
panels.description: A failed compaction pass, and the partitions the cleaner has not compacted since one failed. On a compacted topic compaction and local retention stop together, so a failing cleaner is a disk that fills with nothing else to say so.

panels.title: Offline log directories
panels.description: Log directories this broker took offline, by the startup writability probe or by a live write or fsync failure. Partitions on an offline dir answer KAFKA_STORAGE_ERROR until the broker restarts.

panels.title: Voter lag (top 10)
panels.description: Leader log end minus the voter's durable offset.

panels.title: Quorum loss events / s
panels.description: Alert: > 0.

panels.title: Index projection lag (top 10)
panels.description: Durable offsets the committed object index does not cover yet.

panels.title: Durable watermark and trim frontier (top 10 shards)
panels.description: The gap between the two is the local hot tail in offsets.

panels.title: Barrier epochs / s by group
panels.description: Alert: partial > 0.

panels.title: Delivery activation lateness p99
panels.description: A healthy broker sits at zero. A rising tail says the declared bound is not honest.

panels.title: Schema validation rejections / s by reason
Break-glass refusals and bypasses / s
panels.description: Alert: bypassed > 0.

panels.title: Audit pipeline
panels.description: Alert: write failures or dropped > 0.

panels.title: Remote tier bytes / s
panels.description: KIP-405 traffic to and from the object store. Copy going flat while the topic still produces is the first sign the tier has stalled.

panels.title: Remote tier requests / s
panels.description: Attempts on each of the tier's three paths, whatever their outcome. Divide the errors panel by this for a failure rate.

panels.title: Remote tier errors / s
panels.description: Anything above zero here fires KrabkaRemoteCopyErrors or KrabkaRemoteFetchErrors. See runbooks/remote-copy-lag.md.

panels.title: Remote copy lag
panels.description: Sealed local segments this broker has not finished copying. Climbing means local disk is filling at the rate the tier is behind.

panels.title: Remote delete lag
panels.description: Remote segments a retention pass has decided to remove and not yet removed. Object-store space retention has not reclaimed.

panels.title: Cold-read reader pool
panels.description: The bounded cold-tier reader pool. A queue that is never empty with idle at zero means cold reads are saturating it; rejections mean a Fetch was answered with an error rather than queued.

panels.title: Remote index cache
panels.description: A miss downloads the segment's index object again. A hit ratio near zero with steady evictions means remote_storage.index_cache_size is smaller than the working set.

panels.title: Replication throttle byte rate
panels.description: KIP-73. During a reassignment, a rate sitting at the configured throttle means the throttle is biting; a rate at zero with the reassignment stalled means something else is.
